note: Temperature sweep on open-ended prompts. ONLY temp varied (0.1-0.9); ctx=32768, n=8192, top_p=0.95, top_k=40, rep=1.1 fixed.
methodology_correction: The 'answer_chars=0 -> 100% loop' reading is WRONG for prose. Prose outputs are complete explanations that simply lack a 'Final Answer' marker, so the naive thinking/answer splitter misclassifies them as loops. Distinguish (a) genuine meta-loop (output is 'I need to write X... first I should...' with no deliverable) from (b) complete-but-unmarked output (full explanation, just no delimiter).

0.3.note: Only temp that emitted a poem, but wrong meter (7-8 syllables, not iambic pentameter) and wrong rhyme (AABB not ABAB CDCD)
Mixed meta-commentary + scene fragments, no clean scene

findings: The meta-reasoning loop is CHAOTIC, not monotonic in temperature. There is no 'lower temp fixes it' curve.
Best temperature is prompt-dependent: creative fiction 0.9, strict-form poetry 0.3 (and still weak), code 0.7, expository prose robust 0.1-0.9.
creative@0.9 (7/10) is the single strongest result of the whole sweep — high temp lets the model commit to actual prose instead of re-planning.
Expository prose (medical explanation) does NOT loop at any temperature — the earlier '100% loop' was a false positive from a naive thinking/answer splitter.
Strict-form poetry (iambic pentameter) is the model's weakest creative task: it emits a poem at only one temp (0.3) and even that violates meter and rhyme scheme.
Generation speed stays ~20 tok/s regardless of temperature (memory-bandwidth bound), but WALL TIME explodes on loop runs (426s at basic@0.3 vs 35s for a clean answer).
